question: Calculate the revenue from SaaS Subscription sold to users in South Korea.
schema: Table: dim_users (user_id, name, email, country, is_premium, signup_date) | Table: dim_products (product_id, product_name, category, unit_price, unit_cost) | Table: fact_sales (sale_id, user_id, product_id, sale_timestamp, quantity, revenue, profit)
sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'South Korea' AND p.category = 'SaaS Subscription';

sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'Germany' AND p.category = 'Cloud Storage';

sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'France' AND p.category = 'SaaS Subscription' AND f.sale_timestamp < '2024-01-06';

question: Can you tell me the top 41 countries by revenue.
schema: Table: dim_users (user_id, name, email, country, is_premium, signup_date) | Table: fact_sales (sale_id, user_id, product_id, sale_timestamp, quantity, revenue, profit)

sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS total_sold FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 1;

sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'Italy' AND p.category = 'SaaS Subscription' AND f.sale_timestamp < '2022-01-01';

question: The emails of the top 90 customers by total earnings.
schema: Table: dim_users (user_id, name, email, country, is_premium, signup_date) | Table: fact_sales (sale_id, user_id, product_id, sale_timestamp, quantity, revenue, profit)

question: Find the money made from Premium Support sold to Mexico before 2021-08-31.
schema: Table: dim_users (user_id, name, email, country, is_premium, signup_date) | Table: dim_products (product_id, product_name, category, unit_price, unit_cost) | Table: fact_sales (sale_id, user_id, product_id, sale_timestamp, quantity, revenue, profit)
sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'Mexico' AND p.category = 'Premium Support' AND f.sale_timestamp < '2021-08-31';

sql: SELECT u.email, SUM(f.profit) AS total_profit FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.email ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 100;

sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_users u ON f.user_id = u.user_id JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE u.country = 'Algeria' AND p.category = 'Consulting Hours' AND f.sale_timestamp < '2025-04-14';

sql: SELECT SUM(f.profit) / SUM(f.revenue) AS avg_profit_margin FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Premium Support';
